notes.title: Long-awaited update released!!!
notes.content:
Changes:

 Added character customization.
 Added shop with clothes that affect the style.
 Now you should unlock genres.
 Added more animations for your rapper.
 Steam Achivements.
 Some fixes


Now you can buy RapStar Tycoon with a discount of 30%!

notes.title: Update announcement!
notes.content:
The first update will be coming soon released.

In this update, we'll add a few features that are not enough in the current version.

Namely:
 Creating your own character at the beginning of the game.
 Character customization.
 Shop with clothes that affect the style.
 More animations for your rapper.
 In-game news.
 Other minor fixes.
